cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

mechanism: Copy a scoring move as an opening move, then perform expert rule knowledge by presenting each correction as a planned test.
confusable: Both cards bluff competence, but S04 requires a visible copied model while D210 requires improvised rule-and-outcome mastery.
comparison: Board-game scoring correction versus choosing raffle tickets after a seller's sorting gesture.
seedUse: Retains scoring-marker misunderstanding and stable-scoring ending; adds the missing copied model and replaces the unclear horse/lake premise.
